page.title: KS-Suite: free, private apps
page.description: Free, privacy-focused apps for the TV, the desktop and the phone. No ads, no tracking.
theme.label: Theme
hero.lead: A central hub for Android TV, phone, desktop and local-first apps, with no ads and no tracking. Every download comes straight from the app's newest GitHub release.
apps.heading: Applications
apps.intro: Each card shows the newest release. Downloads come straight from GitHub.
platforms.label: Platforms
install.heading: Quick install notes
install.androidText: Download the APK, allow installing from unknown sources if asked, then open the file to install. On a TV, the Downloader app or ADB also works.
install.desktopText: Each button gives the right file for that system. On a Mac, choose Apple silicon for M-series chips and Intel for older Macs.
footer.privacy: This page has no analytics and sets no cookies.
footer.built: Built and released with GitHub Actions
